messages:
From: Cathy Li <cathy.li@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0000
Subject: SOC2 evidence request ahead of renewal cutover

Hi Naomi,

Quick one from procurement as we prepare Greenline's contract extension: our legal team requires the most recent SOC 2 Type II report or an interim attestation/bridge letter that covers our renewed contract period. Our target PO/contract cutover is July 15, 2027, so we need evidence by June 30 to avoid procurement delays.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II covering a period that includes at least part of 2026–2027 (we typically accept a 12-month period ending no earlier than April 30, 2027), or
- If not, whether you can provide a signed bridge letter or interim attestation that explicitly covers the July 15 cutover window and names Greenline?

Also, please indicate any redactions you require and whether you can provide a copy via a secure link (or a DocuSign for the bridge). If possible, include a simple procurement checklist so our legal team can cross-check items (scope, auditor name, report date, control exceptions).

Thanks — we have a tight fiscal process so appreciation for a prompt answer.

Best,
Cathy Li
Senior Procurement Manager
Greenline Health

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Cathy Li <cathy.li@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 18:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence request ahead of renewal cutover

Hi Cathy — thanks for the clear timeline. We can support Greenline on this and avoid delaying your July 15 cutover. Options below — please confirm which you prefer and whether the June 30 delivery target will work for procurement.

1) Provide the current SOC 2 Type II (redacted PDF) — available and covering the 12-month period 2025-05-01 through 2026-04-30 (audited by Brightline LLP). This report is final and we can share a redacted copy via a secure SharePoint link.

2) Provide a signed bridge letter attesting to continuous control coverage from 2026-05-01 through 2027-04-30, with an explicit statement that controls remain materially unchanged since the last Type II. We can prepare a short bridge letter (one page) that names Greenline and the contract cutover date. Estimated turnaround: 48 hours for internal review + signature.

3) If you require a formal interim attestation from the auditor (QSA), that typically takes longer — we estimate 4–6 weeks to coordinate with Brightline LLP and produce an auditor-signed interim attestation.

Recommended path for your July 15 cutover: Option 1 (redacted Type II) + Option 2 (signed bridge letter) mailed to procurement. That combination satisfies most enterprise procurement/legal teams when the Type II period does not fully overlap the contract term.

I've attached a short procurement_evidence_checklist.xlsx that maps the report fields procurement usually needs. Marissa and Jonas — adding you for evidence packaging and DocuSign prep.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Cathy — looping in the packaging details. Per Naomi's note, we will: 
- Share redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (redacted) via a secure SharePoint link with view/download restrictions.
- Produce bridge_letter_draft_20270620.pdf (one-page) that names Greenline Health and the target contract cutover date (July 15, 2027). The draft will be routed for Naomi's signature and the final will be delivered as a signed PDF.

Attachment stubs included in this thread: redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (redacted), bridge_letter_draft_20270620.pdf, procurement_evidence_checklist.xlsx.

Jonas — can you confirm the exact language we should include for the "materially unchanged controls" statement? Procurement sometimes asks for the auditor name and whether there were any exceptions in the last reporting period — include Brightline LLP and a short line noting there were no material exceptions in the 2026 report.

We will also prepare a DocuSign envelope for the bridge letter if Greenline prefers an executed electronic signature. Naomi — once you approve the draft I will create the DocuSign link and share it with Cathy.

Thanks,

Naomi / Marissa — this is great, thank you. Procurement is comfortable accepting the redacted Type II report plus a signed bridge letter that explicitly names Greenline and covers the July 15 cutover, provided the bridge references the auditor (Brightline LLP) and states that there were no material exceptions in the most recent period.

Please:
- Send the secure link to the redacted report and the final signed bridge letter by end of day June 30 (our deadline).
- Share the DocuSign link if you prefer electronic signature.
- In the bridge letter, add the following sentence verbatim for procurement: "This bridge letter is provided to Greenline Health to confirm that controls described in the SOC 2 Type II report for the period May 1, 2025 — April 30, 2026 remain materially unchanged as of June 20, 2027, and no material exceptions were reported for that period."

If we receive those items by June 30 procurement will proceed with routing the PO to hit the July 15 cutover. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Cathy
